stock.description: Future Bright Mining Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, with its primary business revolving around the extraction and sale of marble blocks across mainland China. The firm possesses an interest in the Yiduoyan project, an open-pit mine covering approximately 0.5209 square kilometers, situated in Hubei Province, People's Republic of China. Beyond its core marble activities, the company engages in the trade of mineral commodities and the wholesale distribution of construction and decoration materials. Its operations also extend to the entire process of marble production, from mining and ore processing to the manufacturing and sale of finished marble products. Additionally, Future Bright Mining is involved in technology development and transfer, and provides consulting services. Founded in 2011, the company is headquartered in Xiangyang, PRC, and functions as a subsidiary of Zhong Ke Jiu Tai Technology Group Limited.
